content.what_it_is: `CAL_DISPERSION` (L61-L490) assembles dispersive FUNWAVE fields from GLOBAL state. It calls centered derivative routines for velocity, depth-weighted velocity and, in CARTESIAN `Gamma2>0` builds, time derivatives (L75-L179); imposes physical-edge zeros on mixed derivatives and exchanges them (L186-L286); computes linear `U4/V4` and `U1p/V1p` terms with CARTESIAN, ZALPHA and spherical branches (L288-L380); and in the CARTESIAN nonlinear branch computes spatial gradients, `U1pp/V1pp`, nonlinear `U2/V2`, corrected vorticity, and `U3/V3` (L382-L488). It has no dummy arguments and obtains all persistent inputs/outputs through `USE GLOBAL` at L62.

verbatim_spans.text: ! 05/25/2018, ykchoi pointed a bug: J=1,Nloc, I=1,Mloc

unresolved: Range/assignment inconsistency: local DU and DV and GLOBAL ETAT are assigned only in loops J=1:Nloc-1 and I=1:Mloc-1 at L102-L118. The source comment at L110 explicitly says the corrected bounds are J=1,Nloc and I=1,Mloc, but the code still uses the shortened ranges. DU/DV are immediately passed to derivative routines over Ibeg:Iend,Jbeg:Jend at L149-L156 and their derivative results are consumed over the full 1:Mloc,1:Nloc loop at L289-L380; ETAT is later consumed at L415-L418. Unless caller/global initialization supplies the omitted last row and column and all stencil halos, these paths read stale or undefined values.

The file documents that Ut and Vt should be evaluated outside the Runge-Kutta loop and that the current placement may affect hot starts at L124-L126, yet computes them locally from U-U0 over DT at L131-L140. The call site's RK and restart ordering is not present, so the magnitude and phase error cannot be resolved here.

Physical-edge blocks zero Uxy/DUxy/Vxy/DVxy and also Utxy/DUtxy/Vtxy/DVtxy at L193-L284, whereas the time-derivative arrays are computed only for CARTESIAN Gamma2>ZERO at L158-L179. Whether all those GLOBAL arrays are always allocated and initialized in other build modes is not established in this file.

CARTESIAN U4/V4 are assigned and may receive Gamma2 corrections at L291-L316; the separate ZALPHA block then assigns U4/V4 again at L318-L325. If CARTESIAN and ZALPHA can both be defined, the second block silently discards the Gamma2 additions. Mutual exclusivity of these preprocessor symbols is not enforced or documented here.

All derivative calls rely on stencil accesses beyond Ibeg:Iend/Jbeg:Jend, but this routine's local DU/DV/DUt/DVt arrays have no explicit initialization outside their assignment loops and no halo exchange before the calls at L149-L178. The required halo ownership and ordering contract must be checked in callers and exchange routines.

The vorticity correction uses imported identifier b2 at L460-L461 while neighboring dispersion coefficients use Beta_1 and Beta_2 throughout L292-L454. The definition and units of b2 are outside this file, so the apparent name change cannot be adjudicated from this source alone.
